description: Source code for MIME type sniffing logic in Chromium, including functions for detecting MIME types based on content magic numbers, headers, and URL extensions.

classes.name: MagicNumber
classes.description: Structure representing a magic number pattern for MIME detection.

classes.name: VerifySizes
classes.description: Template class to verify size consistency between magic and mask strings.

classes.name: OfficeExtensionType
classes.description: Structure linking Office document types with file extensions.

methods.name: MatchMagicNumber
methods.description: Checks if content matches a given magic number pattern.

methods.name: CheckForMagicNumbers
methods.description: Iterates over magic number patterns to find a match.

methods.name: TruncateStringPiece
methods.description: Truncates a StringPiece to a maximum size.

methods.name: SniffForHTML
methods.description: Detects if content appears to be HTML.

methods.name: SniffForMagicNumbers
methods.description: Detects if content matches known magic numbers.

methods.name: SniffForOfficeDocs
methods.description: Detects Office document types based on magic numbers and URL extension.

methods.name: IsOfficeType
methods.description: Checks if a MIME type is an Office type.

methods.name: SniffForInvalidOfficeDocs
methods.description: Detects invalid Office documents with Office MIME types.

methods.name: SniffXML
methods.description: Detects if content appears to be XML or feeds.

methods.name: SniffBinary
methods.description: Detects if content appears to be binary data.

methods.name: CheckForMagicNumbers
methods.description: Checks content against a list of magic number patterns.
